$comment: Single source of truth for the Export LC Portal SharePoint architecture. Consumed by sharepoint/scripts/Provision-ExportLCPortal.ps1. Every list/library/field/view/index below is created idempotently: existing objects are inspected and left in place, never deleted or overwritten.

solution.name: Export LC Portal
solution.listPrefixConvention: Display titles keep the requested NN_Name ordering; list URLs use clean names (Lists/ExportLCs) so Power Fx, REST and flow references stay readable and stable if titles are ever renamed.

libraries.name: ExportLCDocuments
libraries.title: ExportLCDocuments
libraries.description: Master LC documents: original LC advice, amendments, bank instruments, presentation cover letters, payment advices.
libraries.folderStrategy: One folder per LC keyed on InternalLCID (created on demand by the app/flow). Keeps any single folder well under the 5,000 view threshold.

libraries.name: ExportLCInvoices
libraries.title: ExportLCInvoices
libraries.description: Commercial invoices, packing lists and invoice-level supporting documents.

libraries.name: ExportLCShippingDocuments
libraries.title: ExportLCShippingDocuments
libraries.description: Transport and shipment documents: B/L, AWB, certificates of origin, insurance, inspection, beneficiary certificates.

libraries.name: ExportLCBankCorrespondence
libraries.title: ExportLCBankCorrespondence
libraries.description: Incoming and outgoing bank correspondence: SWIFT copies, discrepancy notices, waiver requests, acceptance advices, payment advices.

libraries.name: ExportLCTemplates
libraries.title: ExportLCTemplates
libraries.description: Not in the original brief - added. Holds the Excel import template, presentation cover-letter templates and certificate templates so operational output is version-controlled instead of living on user desktops.

lists.name: ExportLCs
lists.title: 01_ExportLCs
lists.description: Master register of Export Letters of Credit. One item per LC. The original LC terms are never overwritten by an amendment - amendments live in 02_LCAmendments and are applied forward into the current-value fields with a full before/after trail.

titleField.note: Format LC-YYYY-NNNN, generated by the app from 18_WorkflowConfig key LCIDPattern.

fields.name: LCNumber
fields.note: Issuing bank LC number, e.g. 26/BMLCU/40464, OLCT260054.

fields.name: OurReference
fields.note: Advising bank / internal reference, e.g. 2026/ILC/3432.

fields.name: LCYearSeq
fields.note: Legacy '2026#' column from the Excel tracker, retained for reconciliation.

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: CustomerCode
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: AdvisingBankName
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: ResponsibleOfficer
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: ResponsibleOfficerEmail
fields.note: Denormalised for delegable filtering - SharePoint User columns are not delegable in Power Apps.

fields.name: LCTypeCode
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: SightOrDeferred
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: PaymentTermCode
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

fields.name: PaymentTermText
fields.note: e.g. '180 Days From TCN', '60 Calendar Days After Presentation Of Complied Documents'.

fields.name: LatestShipmentDate
fields.note: The Excel tracker calls this 'Latest Date O/S'.

fields.name: MaximumAmount
fields.note: LCAmount * (1 + TolerancePlus/100). Maintained by the app on save - stored rather than calculated so it stays delegable and indexable.

fields.name: UtilizedAmount
fields.note: Sum of invoice values presented under the LC. Maintained by flow FLOW-08 and by the app on invoice save.

fields.name: OutstandingAmount
fields.note: MaximumAmount - UtilizedAmount. The Excel tracker calls this 'Remaining Balance / Exposure'.

fields.name: AmountUSD
fields.note: Reporting currency normalisation for exposure reports on mixed-currency portfolios.

fields.name: LifecycleStage
fields.note: Drives the workspace progress tracker. Derived from LCStatus via 16_StatusMaster.

fields.name: IsClosed
fields.note: Denormalised open/closed switch. Every register and dashboard query filters on this first - it is the single highest-value index in the solution.

fields.name: RequiresAction
fields.note: Stored flag: true when the LC is in Received/Under Review/Discrepancy, or has open discrepancies or missing required documents. Maintained by the app on save and by FLOW-11. It exists because SharePoint cannot delegate an 'in' predicate over several statuses - one indexed boolean turns the Pending Action drill-through into a single server-side equality.

fields.name: LastActivityDate
fields.note: Deliberately not indexed: SharePoint allows a maximum of 20 indexed columns per list and the 19 retained indexes cover every register, dashboard and report query.

lists.indexBudgetNote: 20 of the 20 permitted indexed columns are used. Adding another index requires removing one - see docs/02-data-model.md.

lists.name: LCAmendments
lists.title: 02_LCAmendments
lists.description: Immutable amendment history. One item per amendment, with explicit before/after values on every changed term. The parent LC is never edited in place without an amendment record.

fields.name: ChangedField
fields.note: Primary field changed. Multi-field amendments additionally write one row per field into 10_AuditLog.

fields.name: AppliedToLC
fields.note: Set true only when the amendment's new values have been written forward onto 01_ExportLCs.

lists.name: Invoices
lists.title: 03_Invoices
lists.description: Commercial invoices drawn under an LC. Replaces the 12 repeating 7-column invoice blocks in the legacy Excel tracker with a proper one-to-many relationship.

fields.name: TrackingNumber
fields.note: Courier tracking for the document set sent to the bank.

fields.name: OutstandingAmount
fields.note: InvoiceAmount - PaidAmount, written by the app and by FLOW-08.

lists.name: Shipments
lists.title: 04_Shipments
lists.description: Shipments made under an LC. An LC may carry several shipments where partial shipment is allowed.

lists.name: Presentations
lists.title: 05_Presentations
lists.description: Document presentations made to the bank under an LC. The examination lifecycle lives here; individual findings live in 06_Discrepancies.

fields.name: PresentationDeadline
fields.note: min(transport doc date + LC presentation period, LC expiry). Computed by the app on save.

fields.name: InvoiceNumbers
fields.note: Semicolon-separated invoice numbers; the authoritative link is Invoices.PresentationNumber.

fields.name: ExaminationDueDate
fields.note: Bank receipt date + 5 banking days (UCP 600 art. 14b). Default configurable in 18_WorkflowConfig.

lists.name: Discrepancies
lists.title: 06_Discrepancies
lists.description: Individual discrepancies raised by the examining bank against a presentation. Categories are configurable in 24_DiscrepancyCategories - none are hard-coded in the app.

lists.name: Proceeds
lists.title: 07_Proceeds
lists.description: Settlement and proceeds received against presentations. Outstanding proceeds = accepted - paid; net proceeds = gross - all charges. Both are stored, not calculated columns, so they stay delegable and indexable.

fields.name: NetProceeds
fields.note: GrossProceeds - (BankCharges + CorrespondentCharges + DiscountCharges + OtherCharges).

fields.name: OutstandingProceeds
fields.note: AmountAccepted - AmountPaid.

lists.name: Correspondence
lists.title: 08_Correspondence
lists.description: Bank correspondence log. Every item can be linked to an LC and optionally to an amendment, presentation, discrepancy or proceeds record.

fields.name: AttachmentUrl
fields.note: Points into ExportLCBankCorrespondence. Native list attachments are also enabled for quick drops.

lists.name: LCTasks
lists.title: 09_Tasks
lists.description: Operational task centre. Tasks are either created by users or generated by flows (deadline, missing document, discrepancy escalation) and are polymorphically linked to any portal record.

fields.name: GeneratedByRule
fields.note: WorkflowConfig rule key, so a rule change can find and retire its own open tasks instead of duplicating them.

lists.name: AuditLog
lists.title: 10_AuditLog
lists.description: Append-only audit trail. Written by the app on every save and by flows on every automated change. Users get Contribute-without-edit-or-delete via a broken-inheritance permission set - see sharepoint/scripts/Set-Permissions.ps1.

fields.name: InternalLCID
fields.note: Denormalised so the workspace Audit tab is a single indexed query.

fields.name: IsCriticalField
fields.note: Critical field list is configurable in 18_WorkflowConfig key CriticalAuditFields.

fields.name: CorrelationId
fields.note: One GUID per user save, so a multi-field change reads as a single transaction.

fields.name: PartitionKey
fields.note: YYYY-MM. Every audit query filters on PartitionKey first, keeping result sets far below the 5,000 item list view threshold as history grows.

lists.name: Customers
lists.title: 11_Customers
lists.description: Customer master. Seeded from the 130-row Cust Data sheet in the legacy workbooks, de-duplicated and name-normalised.

fields.name: CustomerNameNormalized
fields.note: Upper-cased, punctuation-stripped. Used by the importer for fuzzy duplicate detection (e.g. 'Kare' vs 'Kare Pharmaceutical Plc' in the legacy Summary sheet).

fields.name: ExposureLimit
fields.note: Drives the Customer Exposure report's limit-utilisation column.

lists.name: Banks
lists.title: 12_Banks
lists.description: Bank master. Seeded from the legacy Banks Data sheet, which held four disconnected columns (SA Banks, Global Banks, 'our', 'there'). Modelled here as one list with role flags.

fields.name: BankGroup
fields.note: Legacy 'SA Banks' maps to Domestic, 'Global Banks' to Global.

lists.name: Countries
lists.title: 13_Countries
lists.description: Country master with trade-risk attributes used by the exposure-by-country report.

fields.name: IsSanctioned
fields.note: Advisory flag only. It raises a warning banner on LC registration; it is not a compliance screening control.

lists.name: Currencies
lists.title: 14_Currencies
lists.description: Currency master with the reporting FX rate used to normalise mixed-currency exposure to USD.

lists.name: DocumentTypes
lists.title: 15_DocumentTypes
lists.description: Document type master. Drives the Document Centre type picker, the checklist templates and the library routing rules - nothing is hard-coded in the app.

fields.name: TargetLibrary
fields.note: Routing rule the upload component uses to decide which library a file lands in.

lists.name: StatusMaster
lists.title: 16_StatusMaster
lists.description: Status master AND workflow transition table. Every status shown anywhere in the portal, its badge colour, its lifecycle stage and the list of statuses it may legally move to are defined here. This is what makes section 35's controlled transitions configurable rather than coded.

fields.name: LifecycleStage
fields.note: Maps a status onto the workspace progress tracker (Received > Reviewed > Active > Shipment > Presentation > Examination > Acceptance > Payment > Closed).

fields.name: BadgeColor
fields.note: Semantic token name from the app theme: Neutral, Info, Progress, Success, Warning, Danger, Muted.

fields.name: AllowedNextStatuses
fields.note: Semicolon-separated status codes. Empty means terminal. The app blocks any transition not listed here and the block reason is shown to the user.

lists.name: UserRoles
lists.title: 17_Users
lists.description: Application role assignment. SharePoint groups control what a user can physically reach; this list controls what the portal shows and enables. Both are applied - see docs/05-security-roles.md.

fields.name: ManagerEmail
fields.note: Escalation target for discrepancy and overdue-task escalation flows.

fields.name: CustomerScope
fields.note: Optional semicolon-separated customer codes. Empty means all customers. Applied as an extra filter in the app for officers who only handle a portfolio.

fields.name: ApprovalLimit
fields.note: Used by 18_WorkflowConfig approval rules to pick an approver by amount.

lists.name: WorkflowConfig
lists.title: 18_WorkflowConfig
lists.description: Central configuration store. Reminder offsets, approval thresholds, escalation days, ID patterns, critical audit fields and dashboard thresholds all live here as key/value rows. Changing behaviour is a list edit, not a redeploy.

lists.name: DocChecklistTemplates
lists.title: 19_DocChecklistTemplates
lists.description: ADDED to the requested architecture. Requirement 14 asks for a configurable, non-hard-coded document checklist; that needs a template layer. Rules here say which document types are required, matched by any combination of LC type, country, customer and Incoterm. Most specific match wins.

fields.name: AppliesToLCType
fields.note: Blank = any.

fields.name: AppliesToCountry
fields.note: Blank = any.

fields.name: AppliesToCustomerCode
fields.note: Blank = any.

fields.name: AppliesToIncoterm
fields.note: Blank = any. CIF/CIP templates require an insurance certificate; FOB/EXW do not.

fields.name: Specificity
fields.note: Count of non-blank match criteria. The app selects the highest-specificity matching template set.

lists.name: LCDocumentChecklist
lists.title: 20_LCDocumentChecklist
lists.description: ADDED. Per-LC checklist instance, materialised from 19_DocChecklistTemplates when an LC is registered. Instances are editable per LC without touching the template, and MissingDocumentCount on the LC is driven from here.

fields.name: PresentationNumber
fields.note: Blank = LC-level checklist; set = per-presentation checklist.

lists.name: Incoterms
lists.title: 21_Incoterms
lists.description: ADDED. Requirement 20 lists Incoterms as admin-managed master data; the original list of 18 lists had no home for it.

fields.name: InsuranceBySeller
fields.note: True for CIF and CIP - drives whether the checklist template requires an insurance certificate.

lists.name: Ports
lists.title: 22_Ports
lists.description: ADDED. Port/airport master for loading, discharge and destination pickers.

lists.name: LCTypes
lists.title: 23_LCTypes
lists.description: ADDED. LC product master driving default terms on registration.

lists.name: DiscrepancyCategories
lists.title: 24_DiscrepancyCategories
lists.description: ADDED. Requirement 28 explicitly forbids hard-coding discrepancy categories, so they need their own master list with default severity and escalation behaviour.

fields.name: GuidanceText
fields.note: Shown inline to the officer when the category is selected.

lists.name: PaymentTerms
lists.title: 25_PaymentTerms
lists.description: ADDED. Seeded from the legacy Payment Term sheet. Tenor days and the maturity basis are captured so due dates can be calculated instead of typed.

fields.name: MaturityBasis
fields.note: TCN = transport/clean collection note, the basis used by the customer's '180 Days From TCN' terms.

lists.name: NotificationLog
lists.title: 26_NotificationLog
lists.description: ADDED. Every reminder and escalation a flow sends is logged here before sending. Flows check it first, which is what stops the 30/14/7-day reminders re-firing every single day - a failure mode that kills user trust in notifications faster than anything else.

titleField.note: Format {RuleCode}:{RecordRef}:{Offset}. Uniqueness of this key is what makes the flows idempotent.

lists.name: ImportBatches
lists.title: 27_ImportBatches
lists.description: ADDED. Requirement 29 asks for a safe import with preview, error report and a record of what succeeded. Each import run gets one batch row; every staged record points back to it, so a bad import can be identified and reversed.

lists.name: ImportStaging
lists.title: 28_ImportStaging
lists.description: ADDED. Rows land here first and are never written to the live lists until an admin reviews the preview and presses Commit. This is the mechanism behind 'never blindly import bad data'.

fields.name: PayloadJson
fields.note: The normalised record as JSON. Committing simply patches this payload into the target list.

lists.name: DashboardMetrics
lists.title: 29_DashboardMetrics
lists.description: ADDED. Pre-aggregated dashboard counters. CountRows() is not delegable against SharePoint, so on a 5,000+ LC register an in-app count would silently be wrong (capped at the 2,000 row limit). FLOW-11 recomputes every metric server-side on a schedule and on demand, and the dashboard reads 20 small rows instead of scanning the register. This is what lets requirement 30's volumes work.

fields.name: MetricScope
fields.note: ALL for the portfolio-wide figure, or a user email for a per-officer figure. The dashboard reads both and shows 'mine' or 'all' on a toggle.

fields.name: DrillTarget
fields.note: Register preset key the KPI card navigates to, e.g. EXPIRING_SOON. Keeps the drill-through configurable instead of coded into the card.
